maps_legend.ne: DHM नक्सामा रातो = कारबाही गर्नुहोस् · सुन्तला = तयार रहनुहोस् · पहेँलो = अपडेट हुनुहोस् · हरियो = चेतावनी छैन।
maps_legend.en: On the DHM maps: red = take action · orange = be prepared · yellow = be updated · green = no warning.

system.ne: DHM ले असोज ९ अपराह्न ४:४३ (२५ सेप्टेम्बर २०२६) आगामी पाँच दिनका लागि मौसम चेतावनी जारी गरेको छ। दिनको रङ जिल्लाको आधिकारिक नक्साबाट हो। यो कार्डमा नदीको जलमापन अंक छैन।
system.en: DHM issued a weather warning for the next five days on the afternoon of 25 September 2026 (Asoj 9, 4:43 PM). Day colours are the district colours on the official maps. This card does not publish river-gauge numbers.

ne: नक्साको रङ: रातो = कारबाही गर्नुहोस्, सुन्तला = तयार रहनुहोस्, पहेँलो = अपडेट हुनुहोस्, हरियो = चेतावनी छैन।
भोटेकोशी करिडोर बुलेटिन-२७ असोज ९ रातिदेखि असोज १२ बिहानसम्म: रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र चितवनमा मध्यम वर्षा, प्रत्येक जिल्लाका एक-दुई ठाउँ भारी।
यो कार्डमा नदीको जलमापन अंक राखिएको छैन।
en: Map colours: red = take action, orange = be prepared, yellow = be updated, green = no warning.
Bhotekoshi corridor Bulletin-27 from the night of Asoj 9 through the morning of Asoj 12: moderate rain in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan, and heavy rain in 1–2 places in each district.
This card does not publish river-gauge numbers.

forecast.ne: केही स्थानमा भारीदेखि धेरै भारी वर्षा, र एक–दुई स्थानमा अति भारी वर्षाको सम्भावना।
forecast.en: Heavy to very heavy rain in some places, and extremely heavy rain in one or two places.

ne: खोलानाला र खहरेमा बहाव बढ्ने र कटान हुने उच्च सम्भावना।
घर, विद्यालय, स्वास्थ्य चौकी र अन्य संरचनामा पहिरो तथा ढुङ्गा खसेर क्षति हुने उच्च सम्भावना।
बालीनाली र कृषि क्षेत्रमा क्षति हुने उच्च सम्भावना।
en: High chance that streams and gullies rise and cut their banks.
High chance of landslide and rockfall damage to houses, schools, health posts and other structures.
High chance of damage to crops and farmland.

note.ne: भोटेकोशी गाउँपालिका र अरनिको–कोदारी करिडोरका बस्ती समेटिएका छन्।
note.en: Includes settlements in Bhotekoshi rural municipality and along the Araniko–Kodari corridor.

forecast.ne: धेरै स्थानमा हल्कादेखि मध्यम वर्षा, थोरै स्थानमा भारी वर्षा, र एक–दुई स्थानमा धेरै भारी वर्षाको सम्भावना।
forecast.en: Light to moderate rain in many places, heavy rain in a few places, and very heavy rain in one or two places.

ne: विद्युत्, सञ्चार, खानेपानी र सडक केही समय अवरुद्ध हुन सक्ने मध्यम सम्भावना।
खोलानालामा बहाव बढ्ने, कटान हुने र सडक अवरुद्ध हुन सक्ने मध्यम सम्भावना।
पहिरो जाने र बालीनालीमा क्षति हुने मध्यम सम्भावना।
en: Medium chance that electricity, communications, drinking water and roads are disrupted for some time.
Medium chance that streams rise, banks are cut, and roads are blocked.
Medium chance of landslides and damage to crops.

body.en: Light to moderate rain is falling in some places of Koshi, Bagmati and Lumbini. A few places in Madhesh, Gandaki and Karnali have rain.

history.note: Bhotekoshi Flood Affected Area's Special Weather Bulletin-27, issued Asoj 9 evening 17:00. Past 24 hours: heavy rain in many places around Gorkha, Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan. From the night of Asoj 9 through the morning of Asoj 12, moderate rain is likely in many places of Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan, and heavy rain is possible in 1–2 places in each district. On the timeline and the Bagmati callout.
Five-day weather warning issued Asoj 8 evening 18:00 (24 Sep 2026). Maps archived as img/dhm/warning-12300-day{1,2,3,4,5}.png. Stays on the timeline as the previous map lead. Not the live card.
Four-day weather warning issued Asoj 8 morning 08:00 (24 Sep 2026). Maps archived as img/dhm/warning-12299-day{1,2,3,4}.png. Stays on the timeline as the prior map lead. Not the live card.

Bhotekoshi Flood Affected Area's Special Weather Bulletin-26, issued Asoj 8 evening 17:00. Moderate rain widely in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan from the night of Asoj 8 through the morning of Asoj 11, and heavy rain in 1–2 places in each district. Superseded as the corridor companion by Bulletin-27 (#12311). Dropped from the live timeline.
Monsoon Special Bulletin-3 UPDATE (Asoj 7 / 23 Sep 2026, 18:00), five days Asoj 7–11. Stays on the timeline as the prior monsoon lead. Not the live card.

Three-day warning issued Asoj 7 evening 18:00, earlier the same evening as #12297. Maps archived as img/dhm/warning-12298-day{1,2,3}.png. Timeline bar covers Asoj 8–10. Superseded as the morning map lead by #12299, which is now the prior map lead. The live lead is the five-day warning #12310 for Asoj 9–13.
Three-day warning maps for Asoj 7–9. Kept on the history card. The live lead is now the five-day warning #12310 for Asoj 9–13.

Bulletin-25. Moderate rain, isolated heavy, Rasuwa/Nuwakot/Dhading/Gorkha/Chitwan from Asoj 7 night through Asoj 10 morning. Superseded as the corridor companion by Bulletin-26 (#12307). Dropped from the live timeline.
Earlier Monsoon Bulletin-3 update. The later Bulletin-3 update supersedes it for the Friday–Sunday window.
